# OfflineShelf

> OfflineShelf builds Wikipedia reading lists for places without internet: schools, libraries and clinics. Build a list from a category, a Wikidata SPARQL query, pasted titles or the most-read articles; combine lists with union, intersection and difference; rebuild them every month and see what changed; export them as TSV, an offline HTML bundle or a ZIM file for Kiwix. Open source (MIT), self-hostable with Docker Compose, launching February 2027 at https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev.

OfflineShelf stores article titles and IDs, never article text. Text is fetched from Wikimedia only while an HTML bundle or ZIM file is written, and every export carries the CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution. It is an independent project, not affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation.

- [Home](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/): what OfflineShelf does, example lists, combinations, rebuilds, exports
- [How it works](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/how-it-works): the five-step pipeline, a walkthrough, versions, schedules, failures, limits
- [Builders](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/builders): category, Wikidata SPARQL, pasted titles, top pageviews, combinations, reading a build report
- [Exports](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/exports): TSV, HTML bundle, ZIM for Kiwix, taking a list offline, attribution
- [Developers](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/developers): JSON API, quickstart, sessions and CSRF, errors, exports, rate limits
- [Self-hosting](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/self-host): Docker Compose install, configuration, email, backups, troubleshooting
- [Roadmap](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/roadmap): milestones M1 to M6 and their progress
- [FAQ](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/faq): 25 common questions
- [About](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/about): why it exists, principles, the maker
- [Security](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/security): protections and how to report a vulnerability
- [Contact](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/contact): support@ahmershah.dev
- [Privacy](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/privacy) and [Terms](https://offlineshelf.ahmershah.dev/terms)

## Developers

- [Source code](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf): Python 3.12 (Flask, SQLAlchemy, RQ), MariaDB 11.4, Redis, React and TypeScript
- [OpenAPI schema](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf/blob/main/docs/openapi.yaml): the JSON API under /api/v1
- [Architecture](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): data model, sources, builds, exports and decisions
- [Wiki](https://github.com/ahmershahdev/offlineshelf/wiki): guides for users, self-hosters and contributors
